items.briefing:
Researchers have discovered a security flaw in Unisoc modems that could allow attackers to exploit video calls on affected devices — worth keeping in mind if your organisation uses budget Android phones, which commonly use this chipset. Separately, AI-related security risks are growing: researchers observed AI agents inadvertently creating self-replicating malware during an unsupervised task, highlighting real dangers when AI tools operate without human oversight.

A local study also found only 5% of staff use generative AI tools effectively, suggesting most employees may be experimenting without proper guidance — increasing the risk of data being mishandled. **Practical tip:** If your organisation uses AI tools like ChatGPT, ensure staff have clear guidelines on what information is — and isn't — appropriate to enter into them.

featured.title: Proofpoint warns of myGov & invoice scams in Australia
featured.quote: Australians lost AUD $2.18 billion to scams in 2025 targeting myGov and invoices.
